summary: Feed s181_triple to IDS is degraded: 3 faults found. Peak bursts hit 2.74 Gbps on a 1 Gbps port (274% overload), 46.7% of TCP sessions are one-way (91/195), and 70.7% of bytes are encrypted exceeding the IDS 60% tolerance. IDS is dropping traffic during bursts and blind to nearly half of sessions.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is delivering bursty traffic peaking at 2.74 Gbps to a single 1 Gbps IDS port with no load balancing or burst buffering. 3 intervals exceeded 80% capacity threshold, indicating sustained microbursts and oversubscription.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS port drops packets during bursts, causing missed signatures, incomplete flow reassembly, and blind spots for detection exactly when traffic spikes.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across 3x1G IDS ports/instances via 5-tuple hashing to keep per-port utilization under 80% and absorb 2.74 Gbps bursts without drops; IDS needs full payload so slicing is not an option.

findings.root_cause: Only one direction of TCP sessions is reaching the IDS - likely asymmetric routing with single-sided TAP/SPAN capture or packet broker not aggregating both directions (client->server and server->client) to the same tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires both directions (needs_both_directions=true) for TCP reassembly and stateful inspection. With 46.7% one-way sessions, it cannot reconstruct streams, misses request/response correlation, and fails to detect attacks that span both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Configure packet broker to aggregate complementary directions and hash both sides of the same 5-tuple to the same IDS tool port to restore bidirectional visibility.

findings.root_cause: 71% of bytes are encrypted (TLS/QUIC) vs IDS tolerance of 60%. No inline or out-of-band decryption is being applied before the IDS, so payload is opaque.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs full payload for signature matching. With 70.7% encrypted, it is blind to most application content and can only do metadata/heuristics, sharply reducing detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: IDS cannot inspect encrypted payloads; selective decryption before the IDS will bring visible cleartext share back under the 60% threshold and restore signature efficacy while respecting privacy policy.
